name: Popzy
author: schorpy

sections.description:
Popzy is a powerful yet lightweight popup plugin for WordPress, designed to help you create beautiful, high-converting popups effortlessly. Whether you’re looking to capture emails, display announcements, or promote special offers, Popzy provides an intuitive way to boost engagement and conversions.

Key Features

  • Gutenberg-ready editor – Design popups using WordPress’s native block editor.
  • Mobile-friendly & responsive – Optimized for all devices.
  • Performance-focused – Lightweight and fast-loading popups.
  • Multiple trigger options – Show popups on click, scroll, or time delay.
  • Flexible targeting – Display popups on specific pages, posts, or site-wide.
  • No coding required – Easy-to-use interface for all users.
sections.installation:
1. Download and install the plugin via the WordPress Plugins screen, or upload the ZIP file manually.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Popzy > Add New Popup to create your first popup.
  4. Customize the settings and publish your popup.
sections.faq:
Is Popzy free?

Yes! Popzy is completely free to use.

Can I create unlimited popups?

Yes, you can create as many popups as you need.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, Popzy is compatible with major page builders, including Elementor, Gutenberg, and others.
